name: Bitwarden
description: Resolve the keys your agents ask for from Bitwarden Secrets Manager, sign agents in to sites with logins from your Bitwarden vault, and offer Bitwarden's browser extension for Site sign-ins.

settings.label: Machine account access token
settings.description: Secrets Manager → Machine accounts → your account → Generate access token. It stays sealed here and is never shown again.

settings.label: Cloud region
settings.description: Where your Bitwarden account lives: bitwarden.com (us) or bitwarden.eu (eu).

settings.label: Organization id
settings.description: The id in your Secrets Manager address: vault.bitwarden.com/#/sm/<this id>/…

settings.label: Vault address
settings.description: Where your vault lives: https://vault.bitwarden.com, https://vault.bitwarden.eu, or your own server's address.

settings.label: Personal API key: client_id
settings.description: Web vault → Settings → Security → Keys → View API key. Signs agents in to sites with your logins; Secrets Manager does not need it.

settings.label: Personal API key: client_secret
settings.description: From the same page. It stays sealed here and is never shown again.

settings.label: Master password
settings.description: Unlocks your logins for an agent's sign-in, which never sees them. It stays sealed here and is never shown again.
